primary_actuals.selection_rule: The active mapping source_globs must resolve to exactly one primary actuals file.

metadata_rules.period_end: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD and not before period_start
metadata_rules.currency: Exactly three uppercase letters, for example EUR
metadata_rules.row_identifier: Exact source-column header; non-empty and unique for every numeric account row

value_rules.numeric_account: An account_id matching a numeric account code is a report row.
value_rules.month_and_prior: Required numeric values for every numeric account row, including balance groups and ignored groups.
value_rules.p_and_l_ytd: ytd and ytd_prior are required numeric values for every group referenced by EBITDA, EBIT, EGT, EBT, depreciation, operating_result or net_income.
value_rules.balance_ytd: ytd and ytd_prior may both be empty for balance groups such as receivables, liquidity and payables.
value_rules.empty_cell: Empty means missing and is never treated as zero.
value_rules.decimal_rule: Use an unambiguous German or international decimal representation. Values such as 1.234 or 1,234 are rejected because they can mean a decimal or a thousands grouping; use 1234, 1234.00, 1234,00, 1.234,00 or 1,234.00. Non-finite values are rejected.

fail_closed_conditions: The active mapping is missing, invalid or resolves outside the instance.
Required report metadata or a required source column is missing.
A row identifier is empty or duplicated.
A required period value is empty or non-numeric.
A numeric account is unmapped or mapped more than once.
An XLSX is malformed or exceeds archive member or uncompressed-size limits.

optional_inputs.budget: Optional only in explicit two-source mode: actual_source and budget_source must be two distinct CSV/XLSX files under inbox/, data/ or imports/, with identical report metadata, mapping version, account identities and reconciliation counts. A one-source run never selects or analyses a budget file automatically.
optional_inputs.open_items: Receivables aging is unavailable and not processed by this pilot, even when optional-looking files exist.
